scenarios.name: Switch to Home while the Modify expansion is pinned

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is pinned and remains open after a click in empty viewport space
the user selects the Home document tab
Home is displayed and the Modify additional command area is no longer visible
the user returns to the part document tab
the 3D Model ribbon is visible and the Modify additional command area is closed
the user opens the Modify additional command area
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
the Modify additional command area closes
